Seats open → Home Dental Assisting Program BLS/CPR Infection Control Coronal Polish Radiation Safety Sealants Contact Us Facebook Instagram TikTok Roseville, CA · 9-week career program Dental Assisting Program Train for an entry-level dental assistant job in 9 weeks. You attend one class day a week plus one assigned internship day, and you practice chairside inside a working dental office. Tuition $2,500 Full program tuition* Payment plan $1,000 down Balance paid weekly over the 9 weeks Program length 9 weeks 210 hours · 1 class day + 1 internship day a week Next open start Mon, Oct 12 Monday class · dates may change Prerequisites None Students must be 16 or older Request a seat Call 916-888-9821 5.0 ★ from 77 Google reviews Download the registration form (PDF) Información en español Upcoming Class Dates October 12, 2026 November 20, 2026 Dates are penciled in and may change; admissions will confirm current availability. Tuition and payment plan Tuition is $2,500 for the full 9-week program. You do not need to pay it all up front. 1 A $1,000 minimum down payment reserves your spot in the next class. 2 The remaining balance is paid weekly over the nine weeks, due at the beginning of each class. 3 Certificates are issued once the balance is paid in full. The deposit and tuition are nonrefundable. The academy does not offer traditional financial aid; it keeps tuition affordable and offers this payment plan instead. How the 9 weeks work From first class to first job 210 hours of training across online lectures, homework, chairside practice, and an assigned internship day. Step 1 Pick your start date and class day Monday, Friday, and Saturday are separate class options — you attend one of them each week, not all three. Admissions confirms which day each start date uses. Step 2 Learn online, practice chairside Online lectures and homework cover the fundamentals. On class day you practice with real instruments, materials, and equipment under instructor supervision. Step 3 Complete your 64-hour internship One assigned internship day a week puts you inside an active dental office rather than a simulation-only classroom. Step 4 Finish with resume and job help After 9 weeks and 210 hours, the team helps with your resume and your search for a first dental assistant job. Step 5 Keep growing toward RDA Add Board-approved certificates such as Radiation Safety, Coronal Polish, and Sealants, and work toward a Registered Dental Assistant license. Curriculum Skills you will practice What students learn and practice during the program. Clinical and office foundations Describe the legal and ethical responsibilities of a dental assistant Demonstrate knowledge of the operatories, sterilization room, and laboratory Identify the structure of the skull including the oral cavity, dentition, and clinical terminology Assist the doctor in charting and notes for patient records Hands-on technical training Identify, describe, maintain, and utilize dental instruments and equipment Identify the uses of dental materials and set up trays accordingly Perform chairside assisting with the doctor under the supervision of an assistant Take impressions and pour up stone models Modern technology exposure Set up a same-day crown procedure with the CEREC machine Learn how to take a CT scan Learn how to operate the Nomad x-ray unit Internship hosting and hours Students complete a 64-hour internship component Assigned externship hours are built into the schedule Students work inside an active office environment rather than a simulation-only space Outcomes What you leave with Chairside experience from hands-on practice with instructors A completed 64-hour internship in a working dental office Resume and job assistance for your first dental assistant role What dental assistants earn near Sacramento See the DA to RDA career path “The 9 week course teaches you everything you need to know to start your career as a dental assistant. After completing the program I had multiple job offers.” Amanda Lehr · Google review Graduate stories Where graduates go next Two of today's instructors started in this program.
